message: Last week during a storm, the power went out just as I was about to read an important email. My phone was at 10%, and there I was, scrambling for my portable charger while balancing a flashlight in my other hand. I realized how much I rely on my tech, especially in those unexpected moments. Now, I always keep a power bank charged and ready—it's a little prep that makes a big difference. Have you ever found yourself in a similar pinch?
